confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer prices are based on Numbeo data for Córdoba from June 2026, as reported by Expatica (inexpensive meal about EUR 12.5, three-course meal for two about EUR 47, 0.5 L draught beer about EUR 3.1, cappuccino about EUR 2.2). Idealista and a travel budget guide gave slightly lower figures. The beer anchor is set a little below the Numbeo 0.5 L price because the local standard serving is often a smaller caña. Cocktail (about EUR 8.5) and glass of wine (about EUR 3.5) come from travel guides and crowd-sourced figures with unclear methods, so they are less certain. Prices near the Mezquita can be 30-50% higher. Search results gave euro prices, and I converted them to USD at about 1.10 USD per EUR. That rate is my working assumption, based on RBA AUD/USD and a mirror site's AUD/EUR rate. I did not search for accommodation prices. Those anchors are model estimates from general knowledge only. They assume July is low season in Córdoba because of the extreme summer heat, so rooms there are usually cheaper than in spring, when festivals and patio season push prices up.
comparable_city_reasoning: Córdoba is a mid-sized Andalusian city with a lot of cultural tourism, similar to Granada or Seville but usually a bit cheaper than Seville. It is cheaper than Madrid or Barcelona.
